intentEvidence: Sync your Obsidian vault with a GitHub repository, on desktop and mobile. No server, no Git on your device.
problem: Users who want cross-device synchronization for their Obsidian vault but wish to avoid using Git locally or manage complex Git workflows.
summary: Gitless Vault Sync allows users to synchronize their Obsidian vault with a private GitHub repository across desktop and mobile devices without using Git locally.
